_doc_top: Strata serve.server run-config template (all keys consumed by serve/server.py read cfg.set). Values marked *validated* come from bench runs of the Gyro-Coder instance on this box (RTX 3050 8 GB, engine 0.1.48); paths now point at the active engine, 0.1.57. Unknown keys are ignored by Strata, so the template carries only documented ones. llama-swap passes --config at spawn; the config loads fresh on every swap-in.
_doc_exe: resolved via STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR (env, set by llama-swap stanza) to components/engine/<active>/strata; or an absolute path or git build. Validated.
_doc_args: Validated 8 GB geometry: ctx 8192 + q4_0 KV + prefill 1024 + reserve 400 -> expert cache ~529-795 slots, decode 16.9-18.0 tok/s. cuBLAS prefill-gemm (cublasCreate status 1) fails when reserve < ~400 on CUDA13/sm_86: raise reserve, never drop below 400 here. k8v4 is the quality KV (kept when context/VRAM allow: revert --kv q4_0 -> k8v4 and re-test). --spec 2 = cheaper MTP verify windows; sweep quality/speed. NOT included: --vision (strata-vision cannot parse the Gyro-Coder TQ2_T gguf header; Gyro-S/M headers work). Nov 5 note: on the Gyro-S door, 0.1.57 A/Bs replaced --mmap-experts with --resident-budget-gib 7 (measured on the abliterated model only); re-test before copying that swap here.
_doc_cwd: paths in args resolve relative here when not absolute. Validated.
_doc_env: engine env settings carried by the config (merged into spawn env). Empty: the engine's own defaults already run STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=7 on CUDA (+10-20% decode), so carrying 7 here only repeated the default; the stripped previous value lives in the .bak. Setting 0 turns tail-skip off (the abliterated sibling door runs 0). Others seen in code: STRATA_IQ_STAGE_GRID=0 (0.2.2 codebook staging off), STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE=0 (CPU prompt share off), STRATA_NO_TQ_KERNELS=1, STRATA_TQ_ISA=avx2, STRATA_FILL_AHEAD, STRATA_SM86_PERF=0.
_doc_backend: cuda (default NVIDIA) | hip (AMD, sysfs thermals) | sycl (Intel Arc). null = auto.
_doc_vision: null disables Strata vision. A dict would be: exe (strata-vision path), mmproj (BF16 for every Flash-Next model), model (this gguf), gpu (bool: CPU reader under 24 GB), max_tokens (int, 300), threads (int, 8), cuda_device. On Gyro-Coder keep null until upstream fixes the TQ2_T header reader.
_doc_images: null default. Set by setup --images for image GENERATION (different from reading images): dict with its own keys served at POST /v1/images/generations.
_doc_parallel: requests in flight per engine session. Also --batch N in args form; cfg wins over CLI 1. Qwen3.6-class engines allow >1. Validated 1.
_doc_idle_unload_s: 0 = keep the engine loaded forever (llama-swap ttl 900 handles unloading instead). >0 = Strata-side seconds of idleness before unload.
_doc_reasoning_effort: The CONFIG default for requests that name one (level from the model's template: none | low | medium | xhigh; high, max and maximum all map to xhigh; xhigh is the template's own default, #1641). A request turns thinking off per-request with reasoning_effort: none or off (spelling synonyms accepted) or chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking: false. Per-request reasoning_effort / thinking / chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking override it. 'none' = thinking off (verified: no reasoning_content at all; answers start immediately). Kept 'none' here because this is the one-shot coder door; the abliterated sibling runs medium with an 8192 budget. External runs of this model family back medium over the xhigh default for agent doors (Kaitchup's 14-benchmark suite: xhigh costs over 3x medium's output tokens; a long RTX 4090 build log: 'default xhigh wastes tokens, high effort self-doubt loops'). Raise to low/medium when multi-step quality beats latency.
_doc_reasoning_budget_tokens: Hard thinking-token cap per request (#123); 0 = none, and a request can send reasoning_budget_tokens: 0 itself to turn a configured cap off. When thinking reaches the cap the server closes it and the answer still finishes; max_tokens counts thinking too, so keep the cap well below the request's max_tokens. The cap only binds when thinking runs that long: the sibling's idle probes think a few hundred tokens and never touch 8192. Relevant only when effort != none.
_doc_sampling: chat-sampling DEFAULTS callers can override per request; these are the agentionai card's recommended values for Gyro files (temp 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, min_p 0.05). runconfig.py registers sampling.temperature/top_p/top_k/min_p, so the sampling block is the one real form: there is no top-level temperature key (an earlier revision of this template said min_p is not a cfg key; that was wrong).
_doc_anthropic_thinking: model (default: thinking follows the model's template) | on_request (only when the Anthropic request asks).
_doc_repeat_stop_tokens: auto-stop after N identical tokens (#606); 0 turns it off.
_doc_aliases: names /v1/models lists and requests accept besides model_name (llama-swap stanza mirrors these).
_doc_cors: browser origins allowed to call the API (wildcards ok). Empty = local-only default.
_doc_telemetry_read_key: Bearer gate on GET /metrics when set.
_doc_api_key: set IF direct reachability from lan (serve serves Bearer/x-api-key on all /v1 routes when present); llama-swap strips/needs it absent. null = local open server. Validated null through llama-swap.
_doc_port: RECORD-ONLY track: llama-swap spawns with --port ${PORT} CLI which wins; standalone use per port 8090.
_doc_before_load: command list run synchronously before an engine spawn (hooks for profile warmup, v2 peer drops).
_doc_slot_save_path: KV slot save dir for /v1/slot saves across engine restarts; null = memory only.
_doc_engine_silence_s: engine-without-output watchdog seconds before a spawn is counted stuck (0 = default).
_doc_vram_elastic: #89x: release VRAM segment when idle (multi-model cards keep desktop+/games alive). Off here: single-engine card.
_doc_expert_profile_save: LEARN a tuned expert profile while serving (writes beside --expert-profile; the tuned one is used next spawn). Validated true during the text test. Cost caveat measured on the Gyro-S door (0.1.57): a saved profile booted back the expert cache at 768 slots where the calibrate profile gives 816; after a learned replay, check that boot's 'expert cache N slots' line before trusting response times.
_doc_mcp: Map of MCP servers (stdio/sse) mounted to tool-calling; empty here (capabilities in llama-swap say tools: false for this model).
_doc_shared_settings: there is a sidecar 'strata-<model>.shared-settings.json' by this config's path with chat settings 'Use for other apps too' shares (reasoning_effort, sampling...). This file is NOT it; the shared file never needs to exist.
